title: Addtip (staff)
body:
Syntax: addtip <text>  |  addtip

Description: Adds a new tip to the rotation shown to players who have 'config tips on' (the default) -- one tip is broadcast to everyone with tips on every 30 minutes, cycling through the list in order so nothing repeats back-to-back and every tip eventually gets seen. With no arguments, lists every tip currently in the rotation with its number, for use with 'remtip'. See 'config' for the player-facing toggle.

&D(Staff only -- requires builder access.)&x

Date: 2026-08-17
